text:
maya: Heads-up — I opened a PR to merge the 429, timeout, and context-limit troubleshooting notes into a single error-ref page. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4289  

samir: Nice. Can we include a tiny SDK snippet for graceful fallback + retry headers? I can add a Node and Python example. 

lisa: Please also add a short migration blurb for customers using legacy 'short-circuit' retries — they saw double retries when switching to the unified handler. One line with recommended header: X-RI-Retry-Mode. 

samir: Agreed. Draft snippet (Node):
```js
// prefer fallback model when 429, preserve idempotency headers
const res = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (res.status === 429) {
  // attach retry metadata for observability
  await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
}
```

samir: Draft snippet (Python):
```py
# use short-circuit fallback and log attempt count
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful'})
```

jordan: For fallback behavior doc, we should call out latency/quality tradeoffs and show an example policy json (keeps things simple for readers). I'll paste a minimal policy: 
```json
{ "preferred": "gpt-4-std", "fallback_order": ["gpt-4-small", "gpt-3.5-embed"], "max_latency_ms": 500 }
```

lisa: +1. Also add a short note about context-limit trimming: show before/after prompt and recommend trimming anchor (system) messages first. A one-paragraph example with explicit command to use console tool 'context-trim --preserve=system' would be great. 

maya: Good call. Can someone own the PR review + linkfix sweep? There's a handful of old links to the SDK retry page that need redirecting to the unified error-ref page.

samir: I can do the Node snippet + link fixes. Will open a follow-up commit later today. 

lisa: I'll own the migration note and the context-trim example. ETA tomorrow morning. 

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 3 broken links, 1 spellcheck warning. See CI details: https://ci.redwood.dev/4567/logs

maya: Perfect. Once CI is green we'll merge. Targeting EOD Thursday. If anyone runs into a weird edge-case (e.g., streaming partials + 429 during chunking) mention it here and we'll add a short troubleshooting bullet. 

jordan: One more thing — add a tiny observability snippet showing the header used for request routing: `X-RI-Route=dedicated` so support can correlate fallbacks with routing decisions.

maya: OK added to checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
